gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-mada: Mada keeps its curves open and its lowercase tall, friendly without fuss. Mada sits under Galaxy, whose letters never thin to a hairline, so the heading feels cut from solid stuff.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans lets its curves open wide and holds a high mean line across every word. Martel Sans does the quiet work, while Galaxy goes for round, bent-wire letters that fill the space like a signal.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-matangi: Galaxy stands up top with loose, widely spaced letters of unbroken line width, cosmic and commanding from the first word. Matangi follows in a hefty, rounded plain sans that reads comfortably.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro reads gently, with a welcoming gap in each c and a high-waisted lowercase. Maven Pro handles the steady reading, while Galaxy takes the loud, spaced-out, starry statement.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-michroma: Wide, tall and stubby-tipped, Michroma gives each letter a generous berth on both sides. And Galaxy's round-tipped pen letters above it make that spacious plain sans feel unhurried to read.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre draws a wire-weight line with an s that opens generously between its bends and a lowercase of cast-iron stature. But Galaxy's cosmic, spaced-out letters give it a worthy partner, both sturdy in different ways.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One hangs very large lowercase eyes on a long line, like laser-cut sheet with one stroke width. Galaxy commands the top; Mochiy Pop One keeps the words below it readable.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Soft, spacious and friendly, Mochiy Pop P One leaves a wide stretch of blank space between its sizable letters. Galaxy's dense cosmic heading above makes the plain sans below feel light.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-montserrat-underlin: Montserrat Underline opens its round bowls like a hollow reed cut open, with lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. Montserrat Underline probably wants a modest size beside Galaxy's loose, commanding letters.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-mozilla-headline: Big-bodied and breezy, Mozilla Headline has a splayed c terminal and a plain sans friendliness beside Galaxy's sign-painter brush. Galaxy's constant-width stroke is the strongest thing here.
